summary: Fastify 5 notes API with password login (DASHBOARD_PASSWORD) and cookie sessions, no test suite; after signing in, PATCH /api/notes/:id without a title crashes with HTTP 500 because the route has no body validation.

defects.summary: PATCH /api/notes/:id casts request.body to NotePatch without validation (POST and GET use zod) and calls patch.title.trim(), so a partial update without a string title throws TypeError and returns 500 instead of 200 or 400.
defects.observable: Requires a session: POST /login {"password": <DASHBOARD_PASSWORD>} and keep the sid cookie, then POST /api/notes {"title":"First"} -> 201. PATCH /api/notes/1 with {"body":"new text"} -> 500 {"error":"internal_error"}; {} -> 500; no body -> 500 ('Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'trim')'). README documents PATCH as accepting any subset of title, body, pinned. Same root cause (cast at line 50): {"title":"x","pinned":"yes"} is accepted and stores pinned as the string 'yes'. Without a session the route correctly answers 401, so the defect is only reachable after login.

notDefects: There is no test script and no test files: the suite must be reported as absent / zero tests, not as passed
The server exits 1 with 'DASHBOARD_PASSWORD must be set' when the variable is missing: intended
GET /health is public by design; every /api/notes route returns 401 without a session by design
POST /login returns 401 for a wrong or missing password; POST /logout destroys the session
SESSION_SECRET is optional; a random secret per process (sessions lost on restart) is documented behavior
Cookies are not marked Secure unless NODE_ENV=production so the app works over plain HTTP locally: intended
Negative or huge limit/offset query params return 400 (zod) and do not crash
PATCH /api/notes/<unknown id> returns 404 before reading the body
Missing login rate limiting is a hardening suggestion, not a confirmed product defect
mustNotReport: Do not report the 401 on /api/notes without a session as a defect
Do not report the boot refusal without DASHBOARD_PASSWORD as a defect
Do not report the test suite as passed (there is none)
Do not report POST /api/notes or GET /api/notes validation 400s as defects
